body.name: Exact \(J=2,s=1\) rational separation certificate
body.construction:
Index \(\mathcal U\) as \(((0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1))\), index \(\mathcal T=\operatorname{Sym}^2(\mathcal U)\) lexicographically by pairs \((i,j)\) with \(0\le i\le j\le3\), and index \(\mathcal H_{2,1}\) lexicographically by the \(38\) feasible type-index pairs \((k,\ell)\), \(0\le k\le\ell\le9\).  Order the assignment orbits as \((0,0),(0,1),(0,2),(1,0),(1,1),(2,0)\), where the omitted coordinate is \(n_{\mathrm m}=2-n_{00}-n_{11}\), and set
\[
 q^{\mathrm U}=\frac1{100}(36,30,1,30,2,1).
\]
In the stated order on \(\mathcal H_{2,1}\), set
\[
\begin{aligned}
 \pi^{\mathrm U}=10^{-8}(&1015984,0,0,11868045,5323822,0,0,5323822,0,2031967,
 0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,16328393,16328392,11868045,9123951,0,0,0,0,5323822,
 0,0,0,0,0,9123951,0,5323822,0,1015984),
\end{aligned}
\]
and
\[
\begin{aligned}
 \pi^{\mathrm H}=10^{-8}(&1674027,0,0,10977951,4888329,0,0,4888329,0,3348054,
 0,1407928,0,0,0,0,1407928,0,0,15653588,15653588,10977951,7427893,0,1407928,
 0,0,4888329,0,0,0,0,0,7427893,1407928,4888329,0,1674027).
\end{aligned}
\]
For every orbit cell \((n,o)\), compute
\[
 a_{no}(\pi^{\mathrm U})=\sum_{h\in\mathcal H_{2,1}}\pi_h^{\mathrm U}K_{hno},
 \qquad
 c_{no}(\pi^{\mathrm U})=\sum_{h\in\mathcal H_{2,1}}\pi_h^{\mathrm U}K_{hno}\tau_h,
\]
and define
\[
 \eta^{\mathrm U}_{no}=
 \begin{cases}
 c_{no}(\pi^{\mathrm U})/a_{no}(\pi^{\mathrm U}),&a_{no}(\pi^{\mathrm U})>0,\\
 0,&a_{no}(\pi^{\mathrm U})=0.
 \end{cases}
\]
Together with the coefficient definition of \(K\) and the displayed formula for \(\tau_h\), these coordinates specify every rational quantity in the \(J=2,s=1\) upper and canonical-segment lower certificates without an external table.
